{{dablink|For other uses of the word "Jarra," see [[Jarra]].}}
The '''Jarra''' is a sept of the [[Chareen]] [[Aiel]]. The sept hold is [[Shende Hold]].

After Rand asks Aviendha what type of trouble could occur at [[Imre Stand]], she suggests it could be a raid for sheep or goats by the [[White Mountain]] or Jarra septs of the Chareen clan. They are the two septs closest to Imre.{{ref/book|4|37}}
